summary: Integrated Google, Meta and tele-calling funnel that tripled qualified site visits for a Gurugram residential project.
challenge: UrbanNest was spending ₹6 lakh/month on property portals but getting low-quality leads, and their in-house team took over 24 hours to call back.
solution: We moved budget to Google Search and Meta lead forms with qualifying questions, launched a project landing page, and connected every lead to our tele-calling team for a 5-minute callback.
quote: ScaleNest replaced three vendors and our site visits tripled in four months.

summary: Local SEO across 7 clinic locations that made MediCare the top map-pack result for 40+ treatment searches.
challenge: A 7-location clinic chain was invisible on Google Maps and relied on expensive aggregator platforms for patient bookings.
solution: We optimised all seven Google Business Profiles, built location and treatment pages, fixed site speed issues and ran a review-generation programme.
quote: Patients now find us on Google first. Our aggregator spend is down by half.

summary: A fast, conversion-focused website redesign that doubled admission enquiries for a coaching institute.

solution: We redesigned the site on WordPress with course landing pages, sticky enquiry CTAs, WhatsApp integration and Core Web Vitals optimisation.

summary: A 20-agent multilingual tele-calling team that qualifies personal loan leads in five languages.
